title: Nintendogs
shortDescription: A touch-first handheld companion experience built around caring for, training, and spending time with virtual dogs.
highlights: A direct touch interface designed around everyday care activities
A distinctive social and simulation-focused use of the dual-screen handheld

signals.label: GameAtlas handheld selection
signals.rationale: A high-confidence Nintendo DS starting point: its touch and microphone-oriented care loop demonstrates a handheld interaction model distinct from traditional button-led action games.
